entity.description: Freenet Project Inc is a Texas-based 501(c)(3) nonprofit that develops Freenet, an open-source decentralized platform for applications that run without centralized servers. We maintain the core protocol plus apps built on it, including River (decentralized group chat) and Harvest (a marketplace). The nonprofit is currently funded by grants and donations, and is seeking funding to harden the platform's security and resilience.
entity.name: Freenet Project Inc

channels.description: Direct bank transfer to Freenet Project Inc (501c3). Email ian@freenet.org for wire instructions.

plans.description: Security work on the Freenet platform: defenses against network topology enumeration and adversarial peer behavior, supply-chain security (signed releases, SBOMs), automated adversarial testing and fuzzing, and the developer time to ship these improvements.
plans.name: Freenet security hardening

plans.description: Contribute any amount to support ongoing Freenet development.
plans.name: Support Freenet

projects.description: Freenet is a decentralized peer-to-peer platform, rewritten from scratch in Rust, that turns users' computers into a resilient distributed platform for building decentralized services. Roughly 1,200 active peers. No central servers means no single point of failure, seizure, or censorship.
projects.name: Freenet

projects.description: River is a decentralized group chat system built on Freenet: group messaging with no servers to seize, shut down, or subpoena.
projects.name: River
